unlisted_practices: Data augmentation with GPT-4o to fine-tune open-source LLMs for extracting and prioritizing medical jargon from EHR notes
Comparison of general vs structured prompts and zero-shot vs few-shot prompting for jargon extraction

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of various LLMs, prompt variations, and fine-tuning/data-augmentation techniques for extracting and ranking medical jargon from EHR notes, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or human-facing deployment practice.
